name: KRN Heat Exchanger and Refrigeration Limited
summary: KRN Heat Exchanger & Refrigeration Limited supplies OEMs in the heating, ventilation, air conditioning and refrigeration industry. It develops and sells thermal management products such as heat exchangers, evaporators and condensers, plus condenser coils, fluid and steam coils, copper tubes, fins and sheet metal parts. Established in 2017, it is headquartered in Neemrana.
